Title: Suresh's Day

Cast

1. Suresh - 36 years, son
Look: glasses, brown sweater
2. Anil - 63 years, father
Look: white kurta-pyjama
3. Anita - 29 years, friend
Look: red salwar-kameez
4. Anjali - 64 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The gym - dumbbells, a treadmill, mirrors
2. The terrace - a water tank, a clothes line
3. The office - desks, computers, a glass wall

Scene 1: The gym - Day

[Suresh stands in the gym. Anjali stands near him.]

Anjali: "Today feels like a good day."

[Suresh lifts weights and grunts.]

Suresh (softly): "Wow, how lovely!"

[Suresh does push-ups on the mat.]

Anjali: "How beautiful!"

[Suresh wipes the sweat off his forehead.]

Anjali (surprised): "Yes, all right."

Scene 2: The terrace - Day

[Suresh stands on the terrace. Anjali and Anil stand near him.]

Suresh: "Let's begin."

[Suresh ties a letter to the pigeon and lets it fly.]

Suresh: "Really?"

[Suresh reads the letter the pigeon brought.]

Anjali: "Careful!"

Scene 3: The office - Day

[Suresh stands in the office. Anjali and Anil stand near him.]

Anil: "What a nice place."

[Suresh answers the phone at his desk.]

Anjali (softly): "Show me too!"

[Suresh presents the chart and points at the screen.]

Anil (gently): "And then?"

[Suresh shakes hands with the new client.]

Suresh: "I really enjoyed today."
